stories.title: TV anchor's killing: Court extends physical remand of victim's husband by 4 days
stories.brief: RAWALPINDI: The physical remand of the husband of anchorperson Rabia Ahsan, who was shot dead at home in the Gulshanabad area earlier in the week, was extended by four days by a court on Tuesday.

stories.title: Political narratives and allegations have a limited 'shelf life', CM Maryam says
stories.brief: JHELUM: Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz on Tuesday said political narratives, allegations and criticism had a limited “shelf life”, asserting that public service and development work ultimately determined electoral success.

stories.title: Pindi court extends husband's physical remand by four days in journalist Rabia Ahsan's murder case
stories.brief: A Rawalpindi court on Tuesday extended the physical remand of Ahsan Tahir, husband of television anchorperson and journalist Rabia Ahsan, by four days in connection with her murder. The court on Monday had granted police a one-day physical remand of the suspect.

stories.title: Public service wins elections as political slogans have limited lifespan: Maryam Nawaz
stories.brief: Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz on Tuesday said political narratives, allegations and slogans could not replace public service, stressing that voters ultimately judged political parties on their performance and the development work carried out for their welfare.

stories.brief: The Punjab government blamed poor air quality this week on pollution drifting from India, where firecrackers set off during the Hindu festival of Diwali over the weekend blanketed much of the north in toxic smog.
